name: 67207 · Wichita, KS
findings: ZIP 67207 (Wichita) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67207 (Wichita) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 67207 (Wichita) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
